sn22.120:1.1: Saññojanīye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi saññojānaṃ ca || taṃ suṇātha || || Katame ca bhikkhave saññojaniyādhammā katamaṃ ca {saññojanaṃ} || || Rūpaṃ bhikkhave saññojaniyo dhammo || yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ || || Vedanā || pa || Saññā || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇaṃ saññojanīyo dhammo || yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ || || Ime vuccanti bhikkhave saññojanīyā dhammā || idaṃ saññojananti || ||
